record_scope_reconstruction: Renewed Arida road/bridge interruption December 6, followed by limited private passenger-vehicle restoration June 3. It is a separate episode from late-November damage and early-December returnee passage.

source_checks.finding: Accessible article excerpt documents cars at General Security checkpoint June 3, temporary exit-lane route and goods trucks still excluded. December 6 closure cited.

Native qualification: The December 6, 2024 formal restriction and contemporaneous road interruption followed renewed strikes. December 2 vehicle passage predates this episode and cannot end it. Reports of a December 13 opening lack sufficient vehicle/category detail to establish a matching endpoint; one-way pedestrian movement into Syria was documented by January 2. UNHCR regional flash update 30, dated June 6, 2025, reports that Arida resumed traffic on June 3 for Syrian and Lebanese nationals in private vehicles. On-scene June 3 reporting documents passenger and taxi activity, while a General Security officer says goods trucks still could not use the temporary route. June 3 is therefore a scoped passenger-vehicle restoration; cargo remains separate. Earlier exceptions and the insufficiently specified December opening prevent an uninterrupted all-traffic December–June closure or numeric duration.
